name: Load-break switch motor operator
summary: Identifies the electrical operating mechanism serving the selected load-break switch.
description: Identifies the electrical operating mechanism serving the selected load-break switch. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Open or close command” at the input and “Switch operating movement” at the output. Interrupting capability comes from the switch rating.
